name: Senden (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged in the upper part with the municipal arms of Senden (a red bend with a tree on white and green).
history: The arms and the banner (flag) were approved on 3 October 1966 and confirmed after the municipal reorganisation on 15 September 1975; the banner is white, red and white striped 1:3:1 with the municipal arms.
